notes.title: Update 1.5.0
notes.notes:
Added a first-person view
Visualization of the terraforming of the planet has been added
Minor improvements

notes.title: Update 1.4.1
notes.notes: Now energy buildings such as a power plant and a water pump are connected automatically without connectors at close range when the building is in the placement mode. It is advisable to build energy buildings last.

notes.title: Update 1.4.0
notes.notes: [p]Major Update: Added [b]creative[/b] mode. Minor innovations: [b]Crystals[/b] can now be made. I also worked out the behavior of enemies and other minor improvements.[/p]

notes.title: AstroPlanet Release
notes.notes: [p]AstroPlanet is already in release[/p][p]Can you turn this inhospitable planet into a thriving place to live?[/p]

notes.title: Release date!
notes.notes: [p]We are pleased to announce that AstroPlanet is coming out on August 5th![/p][previewyoutube="s0ssOSrxcg0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]In the meantime, add to your wish list and stay tuned![/p]
